_epitope_control: The parent's own refold, measured the same way as every design. This is the control for the epitope axis: trastuzumab's epitope on HER2 is known from 1N8Z, so a measurement that cannot recover it here cannot be trusted on a design. Both models are carried because they disagree and only one of them passes. Rerun with scripts/epitope_control.py; the CIFs were on the VM.
_read_this_before_using_iptm: Boltz-2 ipTM barely separates binders from non-binders. On the 91x91 Smorodina matrices, 94.3% of shuffled non-binding pairs score ipTM >= 0.7 (median 0.88) against 99% of cognate pairs (median 0.91). AF3 separates far better: 3.0% of shuffled vs 47% of cognate at that cutoff. So a design scoring above this baseline on ipTM has NOT been shown to bind better. Use refold confidence as a feature, never as the binding score.
_what: The baseline row. Folded through the identical path as every design: same model, same 1N8Z template, same seed, same flags.

refold._binder_plddt_method: mean per-atom pLDDT over chain B. Verified to reproduce refold-score's binder_plddt exactly on designs that went through refold-score.
refold._min_ipae_absent: min_ipae is a refold-score output comparing a design to its refold. The parent has no design to compare against, so it has no min_ipae. Compare designs to each other on min_ipae, and to the parent on iptm/ptm/plddt.
